solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Talk with female, the lady of the house

parts.note: to talk idly is to chat
Elaine is a woman's name, standing for any female

explanation.surface: A gossip with a woman who turns out to be the mistress of the household.
explanation.definitionFit: A chatelaine is the woman in charge of a large household, traditionally carrying its keys.

clue.text: It's not the original ape

definitions.meaning: a reproduction made from an original work
as a verb, to ape is to imitate or mimic

explanation.definitionFit: A reproduction is never the original, and to imitate someone is to mimic or reproduce them.

clue.text: Setback — very sad to get upset about it

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go around the word it
being upset means the letters of very sad are knocked over and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone is very sad at a setback and gets upset about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get upset' rearranges VERY SAD into ADVERSY, and 'about' puts IT inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A setback is a misfortune, and misfortune or hardship is exactly what this noun means.

clue.text: Run in next race

indicators.note: in means the letters sit inside the words next race

explanation.surface: An athlete is entered to run in the following race.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a run not scored off the bat (a bye or wide) is an extra.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a bye, wide or no-ball counts as a run added to the score but not credited to a batsman.

clue.text: What I am when one has one over the eight?

definitions.text: What I am when one has one over the eight?

parts.words: What I am when one has one over the eight?
parts.note: having one over the eight means being drunk, and silly; also I (one) next to nine, one more than eight, gives the answer

explanation.surface: A drinker reflects on how they behave after one drink too many.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One over the eight' is British slang for being drunk. Read literally, I added to one over eight (nine) gives AS I NINE.
explanation.definitionFit: Being drunk makes a person foolish and silly, which is the meaning of this adjective.

clue.text: The shift that is seen after dark

indicators.note: after puts the abbreviation for that is behind the word for dark

parts.note: the dark hours are the night
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A work shift that is only seen once darkness falls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shift' looks like a work rota; here it is a loose dress, a chemise.
explanation.definitionFit: A shift is a simple loose garment, and this is one worn in bed.

clue.text: Not the gardener's favourite little number

parts.note: wee is Scottish for little
D is the Roman numeral for 500

explanation.surface: A small figure that gardeners do not care for.
explanation.definitionFit: A gardener dislikes any unwanted plant growing among the flowers and vegetables.

clue.text: Go astray or slip

parts.note: to err is to go wrong or stray
taken as written

explanation.surface: Wandering off course or simply making a slip.
explanation.definitionFit: A slip is a small mistake or blunder.

clue.text: Purposeful muse

definitions.meaning: as a verb, to muse is to ponder or weigh up carefully

explanation.definitionFit: Something intentional is done on purpose, and to ponder at length is to weigh things up carefully.

clue.text: Anxious when visiting America?

definitions.meaning: a visitor to the USA is within one of its fifty states

explanation.definitionFit: Being flustered is being worked up, and the USA is made of states a visitor will be inside.

clue.text: Turn to celebrity for backing

indicators.note: backing means the word to and the celebrity term together are read backwards

parts.note: a VIP is a very important person

explanation.surface: A star is asked to turn and back away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for backing' reverses TO VIP to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To swivel round a fixed point is to rotate or turn.

clue.text: Popular officer on the whole

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a general is a senior army officer

explanation.surface: A well-liked officer, generally speaking.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking broadly, overall, is the meaning of on the whole.

clue.text: Player given an awful roasting

indicators.note: awful signals the letters of roasting are made a mess of and rearranged

explanation.surface: A performer gets a dreadful critical savaging.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who plays the church instrument with pipes is a player of it.

clue.text: Curbs straggling bushes

indicators.note: straggling means spread untidily, so the letters of Curbs are scattered

explanation.surface: Kerbs edged by untidy, overgrown shrubbery.
explanation.definitionFit: Low stunted bushes and brushwood are called scrub.

clue.text: This section produces bangs, possibly supersonic

indicators.note: possibly means the letters of supersonic might be rearranged into another word

explanation.surface: A part of the orchestra makes loud noises, maybe like a jet breaking the sound barrier.
explanation.definitionFit: The drums and cymbals of an orchestra form the section that makes the bangs.

clue.text: Letter contains record set by one holy man ahead of the French

indicators.note: ahead of places the saint's abbreviation before the French article

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
I is the Roman numeral for one
St is the abbreviation for saint
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A letter enclosing a record, sent by a holy man before the French one.
explanation.definitionFit: The letters of the New Testament written by apostles are called epistles, and the word means any letter.

clue.text: Yet it can provide firmness of purpose

indicators.note: provide signals the letters of yet it can are reworked to produce a new word

explanation.surface: A question of whether something can still give determination.
explanation.definitionFit: Determination and doggedness, the quality of holding firm, is this quality.

clue.text: Yet he still may play Shylock

definitions.text: Yet he still may play Shylock

parts.words: Yet he still may play Shylock
parts.note: a former performer (an ...) might still take a role, and Shylock is a moneylender who demands his due

explanation.surface: A retired thespian might still take on a Shakespeare role.
explanation.walkthrough: Split it EX-ACTOR: a former actor could still play Shylock, the moneylender in The Merchant of Venice who demands his pound of flesh.
explanation.definitionFit: Shylock insists on payment in full, and one who demands payment extortionately is this.

clue.text: Observes and steals money

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who registers something mentally pays attention to it, and a thief pocketing a banknote does the same, literally.

clue.text: Foreign money invested in source of sugar and spice

indicators.note: invested in means the currency is placed within the plant word

parts.note: sugar is extracted from sugar cane
the yen is the currency of Japan

explanation.surface: Overseas cash put into a sugar and spice business.
explanation.definitionFit: This hot red pepper is a ground spice.

clue.text: Correct code used by a student

parts.note: an ethic is a code of moral conduct
L for learner, as on a British learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: Proper rules followed by a student.
explanation.definitionFit: Morally right or proper behaviour is this adjective's sense.

clue.text: Eastern market may supply mongoose

indicators.note: may supply signals that the letters, rearranged, provide a new word

explanation.surface: An oriental bazaar might sell a small mammal.
explanation.definitionFit: This small African burrowing animal belongs to the mongoose family.

clue.text: Off-colour article following piece in paper

indicators.note: following puts the off-colour and article pieces after the chess piece

parts.note: a man is a piece in chess or draughts
off-colour means unwell, ill
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An unwell piece follows an item in the newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: This strong buff wrapping paper is named after the Manila hemp it was made from.

clue.text: Describing a boom in the travel industry

definitions.text: Describing a boom in the travel industry

parts.words: Describing a boom in the travel industry
parts.note: a boom suggests a business surge, but here it is the bang of a fast aircraft

explanation.surface: A report on a surge in tourism.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boom' looks like economic growth; it is the bang of an aircraft breaking the sound barrier, which the aviation side of travel produces.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective relates to sound, as in the bang made by supersonic flight.

clue.text: Relative energy required to go through French city

indicators.note: going through means the energy symbol passes inside the city's name

parts.note: Nice is a city on the French Riviera
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A relative needs energy to travel through a city in France.
explanation.definitionFit: A brother's or sister's daughter is this relative.

clue.text: Lady-killer?

parts.note: not a man who seduces women but a woman who kills game

explanation.walkthrough: A lady-killer is usually a charming seducer; read literally, it is a lady who kills, a female hunter.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who hunts animals is a female killer of prey.

clue.text: Gathers in spare jumble

indicators.note: jumble signals the letters of spare are mixed up

explanation.surface: Collecting together in a sale of spare jumble.
explanation.walkthrough: A jumble sale is a British charity sale of second-hand goods.
explanation.definitionFit: To harvest a crop is to gather it in.

clue.text: Detain in a safe place

definitions.meaning: the strongest tower of a castle

explanation.definitionFit: To retain someone in custody is to detain them, and the central tower of a castle is its safest stronghold.

clue.text: A client I'd made perfectly agreeable

indicators.note: made signals the letters of a client I'd are made into a new word

explanation.surface: A customer says they have made something entirely satisfactory.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that agree in every detail are exactly the same.

clue.text: A fifty to one chance to be this inspired hermit

definitions.note: an adjective, describing the state a hermit is inspired to live in

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A long-shot bet that encourages a recluse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fifty to one chance' looks like betting odds; it is just A, L and ONE side by side. A hermit is inspired to live by themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: A recluse chooses to live in solitude, without company.

clue.text: Born on the first of December in poverty

parts.note: nee, from French, introduces a woman's maiden name: born as

indicators.note: the first of means take only the opening letter of December

explanation.surface: Someone born on the first of December into hardship.
explanation.definitionFit: Poverty is a state of want, of lacking the necessities.

clue.text: One on his way to work a complete change?

definitions.text: One on his way to work
definitions.meaning: a chimney sweep who is spotless before the day's sooty work begins
a total removal and replacement, as when all posts change hands

explanation.definitionFit: A total victory or a complete clear-out of personnel, and literally a chimney sweep not yet sooty.
